# documents — written material in and out

| Part | What it covers |
|---|---|
| `parts/md-document/` | Converts long-form markdown (specs, RFCs, reports, plans, explainers) into a single-file, lightly-interactive HTML document with sticky TOC, scrollspy |
| `parts/markdown-html-orchestrator/` | Use when a user wants to convert any markdown file in their Claude project into a single-file, lightly-interactive HTML — long-form documents (specs,  |
| `parts/md-review/` | Converts a markdown PR writeup or code review (one with ```diff fenced blocks and severity-tagged > [!BLOCKER]/[!MAJOR]/[!MINOR]/[!NIT] callouts) into |
| `parts/read-docs/` | Reading .doc/.docx files via python-docx |
| `parts/diagram-generator/` | generate, refine, validate, and render diagrams from natural language, notes, code snippets, schemas, tables, or existing diagram source |
| `parts/docx/` | Create, read, edit Word documents (.docx/.dotx): tracked changes, comments, formatting |
| `parts/pdf/` | Anything with PDF files: extract text/tables, merge, split, create, fill forms |
| `parts/xlsx/` | Spreadsheets in/out: .xlsx/.xlsm/.xltx/.csv — read, edit, fix, create, formulas, charts |

## Choosing

- Long-form material (spec, RFC, report, plan, explainer) that should be a
  self-contained HTML file someone can read or send -> `parts/md-document/` or
  `parts/markdown-html-orchestrator/` (the second is the general converter).
- A code review or PR writeup with diff blocks and severity tags ->
  `parts/md-review/`.
- Reading an existing `.doc`/`.docx` -> `parts/read-docs/` (python-docx).
- Creating or editing Office files -> `.docx` -> `parts/docx/`, PDF -> `parts/pdf/`, spreadsheets -> `parts/xlsx/` (these are the full toolkits; `read-docs` stays as the quick read path).
- A diagram from code, notes or a description -> `parts/diagram-generator/`.

Decks are a separate skill (`decks`); the anti-slop rules for prose live in
`antislop` (`references/copywriting.md`, `references/prose-editing.md`).
